page.overview:
Who is Starky?

Starky was approached by the Prisoner at a fortress of House Harkonnen in Hagga Rift. He told them to leave until they called him "Starky", which alarmed him as only other members of the Mobula Gang knew him by that name. The Prisoner relied that the rest of the gang had sold him out. He was angered and declared that he was done with the gang and that things had turned sideways since they had started associating with slavers. He agreed to give them the coordinated for a slaver base in which the gang had made a deal.
